==Biography==
Dmitriy "'''Smurf'''" Ivanov was born in Kaliningrad.
===2015 Season===
Smurf joined [[Hard Random]] in January 2015. He was part of the roster that won the [[SLTV StarSeries/Spring Split 2015|Spring 2015 SLTV StarSeries]] and then qualified for the [[2015 International Wild Card Invitational|International Wild Card Invitational]].
